headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 13, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins secured a 7-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, led by Dylan Beavers' home run and three RBIs. Yaramil Hiraldo impressed on the mound with 1.2 scoreless innings and three strikeouts. The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies, securing a 7-1 victory behind Alec Burleson's 2 hits, 3 RBIs, and 3 at-bats. The Tampa Bay Rays took down the Athletics 8-4, with Liam Hicks leading the charge at the plate.

Several key players have been affected by injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Jake Bloss has been placed on the 60-day injured list by the Toronto Blue Jays. Riley Greene is out with a right hamstring strain, placed on the 10-day injured list by the Detroit Tigers. Kyle Karros is dealing with a concussion, placed on the 7-day injured list by the Colorado Rockies. José Suarez has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Athletics due to a right hip strain. Blake Treinen has been transferred to the 60-day injured list by the Los Angeles Dodgers due to right elbow inflammation.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The Miami Marlins traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Athletics acquired RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for RF Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 7-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles in their recent matchup. Dylan Beavers led the Orioles' offense with a home run and three RBIs, while Yaramil Hiraldo impressed on the mound with 1.2 scoreless innings and three strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Phillies 7-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies, securing a 7-1 victory. Alec Burleson led the Phillies' offense with 2 hits, 3 RBIs, and 3 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Athletics 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured an 8-4 victory over the Athletics, with Liam Hicks leading the charge at the plate. Hicks finished with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs in 5 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Rockies Take Down Diamondbacks 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies secured a 6-4 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with Ryan Feltner earning the win. Brett Sullivan led the Rockies' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays RHP Bloss Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays right-handed pitcher Jake Bloss has been placed on the 60-day injured list, marking a significant update to the team's roster.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
